title: Add sort by modification date option
description: Users want to sort their bookmarks by when they last changed them, not only by when they were added or by title. Add that option wherever bookmarks can be sorted.
acceptance_criteria: Bookmarks can be sorted by modification date in both directions
The option is available in the UI and in the API
Sorting by modification date works as expected for archived bookmarks too
